sku_type_complete.format: same as sku_complete for non-bundle SKUs

sku_type_abbott.format: same as sku_type_complete, except bundled packs use gramasi_abbott (e.g. '400 gr x 2 pcs') in place of gramasi

keywords.note: leading space is literal when keyword_typo is empty; keyword_typo itself (e.g. '900 GRAM') is a rare all-caps weight variant, usually null

notes: susubayi_dict has ~70 flat attribute columns beyond the generated ones (segment_*, category_*, mji_* fields etc). When minting a new row, copy the full row of the closest sibling SKU (same brand+sub_brand, adjacent gramasi or adjacent stage) and only change the fields that genuinely differ (gramasi/kemasan/packsize/gramasi_abbott/size_single/tonase, and sku/sku_complete/sku_type_abbott/sku_type_complete/keywords derived from them, plus stage/usia/usia_atas/usia_bawah/subvarc_abbott/new_stage_mji when the stage differs). Never invent unrelated attribute values.
